d: Israel Election 2026 could reshape the country’s political landscape as Arab-led parties are projected to win a combined 19 seats in the 120-member Knesset. Record turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel could give Arab lawmakers greater leverage as Benjamin Netanyahu and opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot face the challenge of securing the 61 seats needed to form a government. Who are Israel’s Arab parties? We explain Mansour Abbas’s Ra’am, the Joint List alliance of Hadash, Ta’al and Balad, their political differences, demands for equality and public services, and their positions on…
